name: Angsana Lang Co Vietnam
short_description: A roughly 220-room beach resort at the Laguna Lang Co destination with a 300-metre free-form pool, an 18-hole golf course, and pool suites up to two-bedroom lofts.
ai_summary: Angsana Lang Co Vietnam is a large family-oriented beach resort at the Laguna Lang Co integrated destination, on the same stretch of coast as sister property Banyan Tree Lang Co, roughly 75 minutes by road from either Hue or Da Nang's airport. Accommodation ranges from garden- and sea-view rooms to a collection of pool suites and a two-bedroom Skypool loft, and the resort shares Laguna Lang Co's 18-hole Sir Nick Faldo-designed golf course, a 3-kilometre private beach, and a roughly 300-metre free-form swimming pool. Guest reviews consistently praise the pool, breakfast variety and attentive service, describing it as a relaxed, unpretentious fly-and-flop beach base well suited to families with young children, though some reviews note dining and drinks prices run high and a few call out that parts of the property could use a refresh.

300-metre free-form swimming pool and a 3-kilometre private beach shared across the Laguna Lang Co destination
18-hole championship golf course designed by Sir Nick Faldo on-site
Strong family focus with kids' club, babysitting services, and varied resort activities
Breakfast variety and attentive staff service consistently praised in reviews
cons: Some reviews note dining and drink prices are high relative to the room rate

research_highlights: The 300-metre pool and family activity program are repeatedly named as standout features
The laid-back, away-from-the-crowds setting is highlighted as ideal for families with young children
Sits within the same Laguna Lang Co destination as Banyan Tree Lang Co, sharing golf and some resort infrastructure
research_watchouts: Total room/suite count is reported inconsistently across sources (roughly 220 to 229) -- treated here as an approximate figure rather than an exact one
A minority of reviews flag high food and beverage pricing and note some areas showing wear

faqs.question: Is Angsana Lang Co good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's built around family stays, with a kids' club, babysitting services, a roughly 300-metre free-form pool, and a 3-kilometre private beach at the Laguna Lang Co destination. Reviews describe it as a relaxed, unpretentious beach base especially well suited to families with young children.

faqs.question: How far is Angsana Lang Co from Hue or Da Nang?
faqs.answer: It's about 75 minutes by road from either city's airport, on a stretch of coast roughly midway between the two. Most guests treat it as a self-contained resort stay, using the on-site golf course, pool and beach, and visiting Hue or Da Nang/Hoi An as day trips rather than a home base.
